request_mainline: MainActivity::onCreate loads app-owned daemon endpoint config

DaemonConnectionConfig accepts legacy active Tailscale profile identity plus host and port, or config-owned remote_registry bootstrap imported from a freehand://daemon/import deep link; remote_registry truth is kept in a companion sidecar while the legacy daemon-connection.json remains a backward-compatible projection for older APKs
removed top-level transport, relay, and alternate endpoint fields are explicit errors; relay is valid only as a remote_registry daemon endpoint with account relayUrl

AndroidApkUpdater checks the explicitly selected endpoint update manifest in the background and compares it with the installed package versionCode: Tailscale/direct endpoints use the daemon /android/update.json and remote_registry Relay endpoints use the account Relay root /relay/updates/latest.json

AndroidApkUpdater is generation-fenced: each replacement invalidates the previous in-flight check so stale status or installer handoff cannot target the old host; Relay root-relative apkUrl values keep the deployment prefix used by the manifest
MainActivity.AndroidApkUpdateBridge::check lets daemon WebUI Settings manually trigger the same AndroidApkUpdater path without moving version comparison, download, or install policy into JavaScript
MainActivity records the latest APK update status and replays it after WebUI page load so startup auto-check and manual Settings checks are observable

MainActivity::requestInstallFileAccessIfNeeded runs once per package install/update marker during startup, requests supported runtime file/media permissions, opens Android 11+ package all-files-access settings when needed, and records FreehandFileAccess logcat truth
MainActivity::requestInstallNotificationPermissionIfNeeded requests Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS once per package install/update marker before WebView notification bridge use

MainActivity::onCreate renders a native neutral startup overlay before WebView navigation and immediately loads the canonical daemon WebUI URL with client=android-webview; daemon HTML and no-store assets own WebUI versioning

after WebUiStartupGate accepts the canonical shell, MainActivity::requestAndroidComposerEntry invokes window.__freehandOpenAndroidComposerForReadyHost so the app launch reaches SessionDetail with a visible focusable composer and the platform IME can be served; Android stays a thin bridge and never owns route/composer truth

native connection repair: MainActivity always exposes an open-connections button on startup error and opens ConnectionsActivity on click, recreating AndroidApkUpdater from the selected HostConfig on RESULT_OK; the legacy Tailscale host/port dialog is suppressed for remote_registry configs but the connection-settings entry remains available so a remote_registry failure is still repairable
WebUI owns ADP query/subscribe/command, settings, lifecycle dashboard, transcript, composer, and error rendering
Android physical Back asks the canonical WebUI hook to close focused fields, dialogs, sheets, or drawers before Activity exit or WebView history navigation
Android only exposes the system file-picker bridge for WebUI attachment controls
Android exposes FreehandAndroidNotifications.turnFinished only as a native bridge for daemon WebUI turn-finished notification requests
response_mainline: daemon root returns the canonical WebUI shell and mobile layout attributes

remote_registry import persists scanned account, daemon, active endpoint, endpoint candidates, and one-time credential in app-owned registry sidecar before WebView navigation, while also rewriting the legacy config file to a connection-compatible projection older APKs can still read

a positive higher-version daemon APK manifest with a relative or http(s) APK URL plus required SHA-256, byte size, and signer certificate identity downloads the APK into app cache, verifies package identity and all integrity fields, and opens Android's system package installer with a FileProvider URI; current or older legacy manifests may omit integrity fields because they produce no update plan
APK update status phases are pushed to window.__freehandAndroidApkUpdateStatus for the daemon WebUI Settings card
File-access startup permission status is logged as FreehandFileAccess rows for requested, settings handoff, granted, restricted, or settings-unavailable states
Notification startup permission status, missing-permission outcomes, duplicate suppression, and posted turn-finished notifications are logged as FreehandNotification rows
Turn-finished notifications route taps back to MainActivity through the existing Android package launch intent

WebViewClient::onPageFinished starts canonical WebUI selector/layout/asset readiness probing and removes the startup overlay only after WebUiStartupGate accepts the Android WebUI shell, applied stylesheet, and module-JavaScript probe
after startup readiness, WebUI routes the Android ready-host bridge to SessionDetail with a visible focused composer, or the WebUI exposes an explicit Android input-prep failure status
MainActivity::handleAndroidBackPressed treats a true result from window.__freehandHandleAndroidBack as handled UI navigation and otherwise falls through to WebView history or Activity finish
Android file-picker result returns URI metadata to window.__freehandAndroidAttachmentSelected
error_mainline: config parse/load failure is an explicit Android startup failure
unknown config fields, including removed ADP/SSE/command path or top-level relay fields, are rejected rather than ignored or migrated

APK update manifest parse errors, missing integrity fields on a higher-version update, invalid supplied integrity fields, non-positive versions, non-http absolute APK URLs, HTTP download failures, empty or mismatched files/package/signer identity, or installer handoff failures are logged as FreehandApkUpdate errors and do not become false upgrade success
concurrent Settings clicks return an already_checking status instead of starting duplicate update checks

runtime permission denial or Android all-files settings denial remains visible as FreehandFileAccess restricted status and does not cause repeated prompts during later file actions in the same package install marker

notification permission denial remains visible as FreehandNotification missing-permission status; Android does not repeatedly prompt in the same package install marker and does not pretend the notification was posted

unsupported bootstrap kind/schema, malformed base64/JSON, expired bootstrap, missing credential, unknown daemon endpoint, relay endpoint without account relayUrl, or unsupported endpoint kind is an explicit startup/import error
WebView network failure remains a WebView/network failure; Android does not render local fallback UI
missing FreehandWebUiLayout evidence is a device-validation failure
missing or false WebUI back-hook handling falls through to normal Android navigation or exit instead of fabricating native drawer truth
missing, malformed, wrong-client, stylesheet-not-applied, or WebUI-JavaScript-not-ready startup probes leave the startup state visible instead of pretending the app is ready

call_table.output_semantic: startup overlay plus WebView loading http://<host>:<port>/?client=android-webview

call_table.responsibility: render the native daemon connection configuration list from the app-owned DaemonConnectionConfigStore
call_table.output_semantic: saved daemon profile rows plus empty state

call_table.responsibility: add or replace a saved daemon profile and persist it through the app-owned DaemonConnectionConfigStore
call_table.input_semantic: profile id, host, port from the native add/edit form
call_table.output_semantic: updated app-owned daemon-connection.json and refreshed profile list

call_table.responsibility: switch the selected active daemon profile and persist it through the app-owned DaemonConnectionConfigStore
call_table.input_semantic: profile id from the native switch action
call_table.output_semantic: updated activeProfile in app-owned daemon-connection.json and refreshed marker

call_table.responsibility: remove a saved daemon profile, reject removing the last profile, and persist the next active selection through the app-owned store
call_table.input_semantic: profile id from the native delete action
call_table.output_semantic: updated app-owned daemon-connection.json and refreshed profile list

call_table.responsibility: launch ConnectionsActivity from the legacy Tailscale startup-error connection-config entry and, on RESULT_OK, recreate AndroidApkUpdater from the selected active host config and reload the canonical daemon WebUI
call_table.input_semantic: startup error state plus ConnectionsActivity RESULT_OK result
call_table.output_semantic: active HostConfig applied to currentHostConfig and AndroidApkUpdater, then WebView navigating to the selected daemon WebUI URL
call_table.caller: MainActivity::onCreate connectionsLauncher registration / startup overlay error path / Android framework activity result

call_table.responsibility: adapt Android context to app-owned config and bundled first-run JSON
call_table.output_semantic: DaemonConnectionConfigStore
call_table.callee: app files dir plus asset reader

call_table.responsibility: read/bootstrap, strictly validate legacy Tailscale or config-owned remote_registry schema, import daemon bootstrap links, and select the already-declared active daemon endpoint
call_table.input_semantic: app-owned JSON, bundled daemon JSON, or freehand://daemon/import bootstrap link
call_table.output_semantic: HostConfig or explicit config error

call_table.responsibility: build daemon origin, canonical Android WebUI URL, and the explicit selected APK update manifest URL
call_table.input_semantic: host and port plus optional account Relay URL
call_table.output_semantic: http://<host>:<port>, client=android-webview URL, and daemon /android/update.json or Relay /relay/updates/latest.json

call_table.responsibility: route WebUI input type=file to Android system picker and project redacted WebView console diagnostics without changing UI truth
call_table.input_semantic: WebUI file chooser request or console event
call_table.output_semantic: selected URI array, explicit picker failure, or console level/line FreehandWebConsole diagnostic
call_table.callee: Android activity result API and Logcat

call_table.responsibility: route WebUI attachment buttons to Android system picker
call_table.output_semantic: picker launch

call_table.responsibility: return selected Android URI metadata to the canonical WebUI attachment hook
call_table.output_semantic: window.__freehandAndroidAttachmentSelected(kind, files)

call_table.responsibility: log canonical WebUI selector/layout/style/script evidence, retry a bounded module-bootstrap readiness window, and hide startup overlay only after canonical shell plus asset readiness
call_table.output_semantic: FreehandWebUiLayout logcat row plus startup overlay readiness decision

call_table.responsibility: accept only canonical Android WebUI shell, applied stylesheet, and module-JS-ready probe before native startup overlay removal
call_table.output_semantic: ready/not-ready decision plus status text

call_table.responsibility: invoke the Android-only canonical WebUI ready-host composer bridge after startup readiness so app launch reaches SessionDetail with a visible focusable composer
call_table.input_semantic: ready verdict plus canonical Android WebView page
call_table.output_semantic: window.__freehandOpenAndroidComposerForReadyHost() request and android_composer_entry_requested logcat truth

call_table.responsibility: ask the canonical WebUI to handle focused field, dialog, Header tree, Agent sheet, or mobile drawer back intent before native exit or history navigation
call_table.output_semantic: WebUI-handled no-op, WebView history navigation, or Activity finish

call_table.responsibility: derive launcher PNGs from assets/logo.png
call_table.output_semantic: density-specific launcher PNGs

call_table.responsibility: verify launcher dimensions and exact source-derived pixels
call_table.output_semantic: success or explicit drift failure

call_table.responsibility: verify APK foreground state, canonical WebUI layout evidence, and FreehandFileAccess startup permission evidence on an explicit device
call_table.output_semantic: passed, blocked, or failed artifact directory

call_table.responsibility: persist and read the user's APK auto-check-on-launch preference in app SharedPreferences and surface it to the WebUI Settings Android APK update status card through the same updater owner
call_table.output_semantic: persisted auto-check flag plus UI-safe projection of current auto-check state
call_table.notes: auto-check-on-launch is a user preference, distinct from a manual check; both flows share the same updater owner and generation fence

call_table.responsibility: check the explicitly selected daemon or Relay update manifest against installed version without blocking canonical WebUI startup, rejecting non-positive versions and non-http absolute APK URLs, requiring SHA-256, byte size, and signer certificate identity for higher versions, rebasing a root-relative relay apkUrl under the manifest relay root for prefixed deployments, and discarding stale results when the active host changed mid-check via the updater generation fence
call_table.output_semantic: generation-guarded status callbacks (checking/available/downloading/downloaded, installer_started emitted inside the atomic guard after startActivity) plus current-version no-op log or valid higher-version update plan with prefix-correct resolved apkUrl
call_table.notes: manifest parse validates sha256, size, and signerSha256 when supplied; updatePlan requires all three for a higher version and carries them into ApkUpdatePlan; current or older legacy manifests create no plan; downloadApk verifies byte size, APK SHA-256, package name, and signer certificate SHA-256 before installer handoff

call_table.responsibility: let daemon WebUI Settings request a manual Android APK update check and display the native-selected manifest URL through the same updater owner
call_table.output_semantic: updater check started, native manifest URL, or explicit unavailable status

call_table.responsibility: record the latest APK update status and push it to the daemon WebUI status callback, including replay after page load
call_table.output_semantic: window.__freehandAndroidApkUpdateStatus(payload)

call_table.responsibility: download the manifest-selected higher-version APK into app cache
call_table.input_semantic: resolved relative/http(s) APK URL + target versionCode + required sha256, byte size, and signerSha256
call_table.output_semantic: cached APK file verified against manifest size, hash, package name, and signer identity

call_table.responsibility: handoff the cached APK to Android's system package installer
call_table.output_semantic: ACTION_VIEW package installer intent with FileProvider URI

call_table.responsibility: request supported runtime file/media permissions once per package install/update marker during startup
call_table.input_semantic: package permission state plus prompted install-marker preference
call_table.output_semantic: runtime permission dialog, all-files settings handoff, or already-granted status

call_table.responsibility: open Android 11+ package all-files-access settings when broad storage access is not granted
call_table.input_semantic: package name plus all-files permission state
call_table.output_semantic: settings activity result or settings-unavailable status
call_table.caller: runtime permission result or startup permission request

call_table.responsibility: project startup file-access permission state to logcat for true-device verification
call_table.input_semantic: phase plus runtime and all-files status
call_table.output_semantic: FreehandFileAccess logcat row
call_table.caller: startup permission request and settings result

call_table.responsibility: request POST_NOTIFICATIONS once per package install/update marker on Android 13+ before turn-finished notifications are needed
call_table.input_semantic: package install marker plus current notification permission state
call_table.output_semantic: runtime notification permission dialog, already-granted state, not-applicable state, or startup request log

call_table.responsibility: post one native notification for a terminal WebUI turn and route taps back to MainActivity
call_table.input_semantic: FreehandAndroidNotifications.turnFinished payload with session_id, turn_id, terminal status, title, and text
call_table.output_semantic: Android notification or explicit missing-permission/duplicate/invalid status

call_table.responsibility: project notification permission and post outcomes to logcat for true-device verification
call_table.input_semantic: notification permission/post phase plus optional turn id evidence
call_table.output_semantic: FreehandNotification logcat row
call_table.caller: startup permission request and turn-finished notification bridge

shared_functions.purpose: provide true-device evidence that the canonical WebUI rendered
shared_functions.why_shared: device validation and runtime page-load evidence must use the same canonical WebUI selector probe

sync_status: Android native conversation/settings/update fallback files are physically deleted.
bridge.html, Android ADP/SSE/HTTP UI transports, native projector, native controllers, and Android mock route/assets are removed.

Android app-owned config contains legacy active Tailscale host/port plus a backward-compatible projection of config-owned remote_registry bootstrap truth; removed transport and top-level relay fields fail explicitly.

Android imports remote_registry bootstrap links and loads declared Tailscale/IPv4/IPv6/relay WebUI endpoints, but does not own account directory truth, route scoring, live health probing, Tailscale OS connection, or relay tunnel semantics.

Android APK update routes remain daemon-owned release distribution endpoints; Android owns only manifest check, cache download, status bridge, and system package-installer handoff, not a native update panel or silent package replacement.

Android file access startup prompting is package permission truth plus FreehandFileAccess logcat projection; it does not add a native product UI, silently grant permissions, or move daemon/Worker filesystem semantics into Android.
Android notification prompting and turn-finished notification posting are package notification truth plus FreehandNotification logcat projection; daemon WebUI owns when a live turn is finished.
